resources.string: Update the app from Google Play for new features and fixes.
The drawing items in the app receive updates from our remote server
No downloaded package content for this window.
Edit points / lines: drag a point or its handle to move it, tap to select.
Point selected: delete it or switch its line between corner and curve.
Drag panel (docks to the nearest side)
Shadow, colour, light and edges are computed on your device from the background. The original image is kept; you can remove the effect any time.
The scene could not be analysed (the image may not be loaded).
Feet are set on the ground and size follows the distance to the horizon (aspect kept). Adjust the horizon, ground line and scale by hand if needed.
No horizon found: eye level assumed, adjust by hand.
Sets the brush colour to the colour where you tap on the canvas. Nothing is drawn.
Drag a box: the elements inside are selected and can be scaled by hand from the corners. Nothing is drawn.
Draw a closed line: the elements inside it are selected. The line is not added to the canvas.
Gives the selected object a shadow, colour, light and edges that match the background. Preview, then apply; the original image is kept.
Sits the selected object on the ground and sizes it by the horizon (aspect kept). If no horizon is found you set it by hand.
Balloons, shapes and diagrams from downloaded packages. The image you tap is added to the canvas.
When on, only the kids drawing mode is visible; other canvases and canvas types cannot be opened. It turns on automatically for accounts under 12. A parent PIN is needed to turn it off.
Only kids drawing and the drawing challenge are available. A parent can turn the lock off in Settings with the PIN.
Parent: set a 4-digit PIN to manage the lock.
Too many wrong attempts. Wait a little and try again.
No PIN has been set yet
The PINs do not match, enter again
